status.description: The issue is open and ready for the assignee to start work on it.

comments.comment:
There are several remaining tickets which are related to this issue, such as LU-18532, LU-18382, and
this should not a quota issue but a test timing issue.

The write that crosses the soft limit also has to write back the data written before the limit was reached,
on a loaded system that 10KB write could take tens of seconds, so the grace timer can be over before
the test reaches "Write before timer goes off" (it hit more often on ZFS backend)

https://testing.whamcloud.com/test_sets/f0b23f48-9c2b-4c39-8548-e542818befb5
